record_scope_reconstruction: Jhulaghat pedestrian suspension bridge over the Kali River, connecting Baitadi with Pithoragarh. The recorded election order and emergency exceptions are retained without claiming an observed reopening.

source_checks.finding: Indexed original RSS report gives October 3–5 order for Baitadi; emergency passage allowed and Darchula dates separate.
Official bridge inventory supplies coordinates and pedestrian suspension-bridge identity; provisional data status retained.
District government explicitly identifies the hanging bridge as entry to Nepal.
October 5 report explicitly confirms closure of the Jhoolaghat bridge; reported reopening expectations remain unverified.

sites.name: Jhulaghat pedestrian suspension bridge

sites.evidence_note: PWD identifies Jhulaghat pedestrian suspension bridge over Kali River; district government describes it as the entry bridge into Nepal. Inventory construction year differs from historical descriptions and is not used to date the restriction.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Jhulaghat pedestrian suspension bridge over the Kali River, connecting Baitadi with Pithoragarh. The recorded election order and emergency exceptions are retained without claiming an observed reopening.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: Nepali officials scheduled October 3 at 17:00 through October 5 at 17:00; Indian district reporting instead gives early October 6. Closure implementation is documented, but actual reopening is not. Emergency passage remained discretionary; later Darchula restrictions are separate.
